title: AI Python for Beginners
about: Python with AI assistance: writing, testing and debugging code, ending in small AI apps.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: write a script that reads a CSV, cleans it and prints three summary numbers
Checkpoint: call a function you wrote from a second file and add one test

title: CS50P: Introduction to Programming with Python
about: A rigorous, free Python course with problem sets. Use it if you want stronger fundamentals than a quick tour.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: finish the problem sets on functions, loops and file I/O

title: Kaggle Learn: Python, Pandas, Data Visualization
about: Short interactive lessons with a notebook in the browser. This is the fastest route to NumPy and Pandas habits.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: load a public dataset, clean it, and plot three insights in a notebook

title: Essence of Linear Algebra
about: Visual intuition for vectors, matrices, and transformations. Watch it before any ML course.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: explain matrix multiplication as a change of basis in your own words

title: Essence of Calculus
about: Derivatives, the chain rule and integrals as pictures. The chain rule is the heart of backpropagation.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: compute the gradient of f(x, y) = x^2 + 3xy by hand

title: Machine Learning Crash Course
about: Concise lessons with exercises on regression, classification, data, and evaluation.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: explain overfitting, regularization and the train/validation/test split to a friend
Checkpoint: pick precision or recall for a spam filter and defend the choice

title: Kaggle Learn: Intro and Intermediate Machine Learning
about: Hands-on scikit-learn: decision trees, random forests, validation, and handling missing data.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: enter a Kaggle tabular competition and submit one baseline model

title: Stanford CS229: Machine Learning
about: The math-heavy version. Take it if you are aiming at ML engineer roles rather than application work.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: derive the gradient of the logistic regression loss

title: Machine Learning Specialization
by: Andrew Ng, Stanford Online and DeepLearning.AI
about: Three courses on supervised learning, neural networks and trees, then unsupervised learning and recommenders. The Coursera page says it is not free.

title: Neural Networks
about: A visual bridge into deep learning: what a neural network is, how it learns, and what backpropagation computes.

title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
about: Build backpropagation, a bigram model, an MLP, a WaveNet-style model, and GPT from scratch in code.

lessons.t: The spelled-out intro to neural networks and backpropagation: micrograd
The spelled-out intro to language modeling: makemore
Building makemore Part 3: Activations, gradients, BatchNorm
Building makemore Part 4: Becoming a backprop ninja
Building makemore Part 5: Building a WaveNet
Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out

title: Karpathy: LLM talks and GPT-2 reproduction
about: A one-hour overview of LLMs, a long deep dive into how ChatGPT-style models are trained, and a full GPT-2 reproduction.

lessons.t: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT

title: The Illustrated Transformer
about: The clearest picture-first explanation of self-attention and the transformer block.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: draw queries, keys and values for a three-word sentence and compute the attention weights

title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
about: A top-down, code-first course. Good if you learn best by training real models first and reading theory later.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: train an image classifier on your own images and share the notebook

title: Dive into Deep Learning
about: An interactive textbook with runnable PyTorch code. Use it as the reference while doing other courses.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: implement softmax regression from scratch and compare with the library version

title: Stanford CS224n: NLP with Deep Learning
about: Word vectors through transformers and pretraining. Best for the ML engineer path.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: implement scaled dot-product attention with masking in NumPy

title: ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers
about: Short course on writing reliable prompts and calling an LLM from code for summarizing, inferring, transforming, and expanding.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: build a Node endpoint that returns validated JSON from an LLM call

title: Hugging Face LLM Course
about: Transformers, tokenizers, datasets, fine-tuning, and reasoning models using the Hugging Face libraries.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: run a pretrained model locally and inspect its tokenization
Checkpoint: fine-tune a small model on a narrow dataset with LoRA

title: a smol course: post-training
about: Instruction tuning and preference alignment on small models.

title: Generative AI with Large Language Models
about: The generative AI lifecycle: transformer architecture, training and tuning methods, and inference.

title: Post-training of LLMs
about: SFT, DPO and online reinforcement learning in a short hands-on course.

title: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
about: Architecture, retrieval, evaluation, and deployment of production-ready RAG applications.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: index five PDFs into a vector store and answer questions with source citations
Checkpoint: write 20 test questions and measure retrieval hit rate at k=4

title: Agentic AI
about: Iterative, multi-step workflows where an LLM plans, acts with tools, reflects, and improves its own output.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: build an agent with two tools, a step limit, and error handling

title: MCP: Build Rich-Context AI Apps with Anthropic
about: The Model Context Protocol: expose tools, data and prompts to AI apps through one standard interface.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: write a small MCP server in Node or Python that exposes one tool

title: Hugging Face Agents Course
about: Build and deploy your own AI agents, from fundamentals through frameworks.

title: Claude API documentation
about: Reference for tool use, streaming, structured outputs, prompt caching and evaluation with the Claude API.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: stream a response to a React page through a Node route

title: FastAPI Tutorial
about: Serve models and LLM pipelines as validated HTTP APIs in Python.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: wrap a scikit-learn model in a /predict endpoint with request validation

title: Made With ML
about: How to design, develop, deploy and iterate on production ML systems.

title: Full Stack Deep Learning
about: The end-to-end view of shipping ML products: data, training, deployment, monitoring, and teams.

title: MLOps Zoomcamp
about: Experiment tracking, pipelines, deployment, and monitoring with hands-on modules.

title: Fast and Efficient LLM Inference with vLLM
about: Optimize, deploy and benchmark an open-source LLM with vLLM.

title: Docker: Get Started
about: Containerize your service so it runs the same on your laptop and in the cloud.

lessons.t: Checkpoint: containerize your RAG backend and run it with docker compose
